population.note: Every candidate carries a decision AND a reason; every stage-2 candidate has a retained thumbnail on disk and appears on a contact sheet. The previous manifest claimed ">= 2,000 candidates actually screened" with no artefact behind it (3-4 I-P34-001).

invalidation: Any geometry-affecting renderer change invalidates this manifest, its thumbnails and anchor evidence; bump engineGeometryVersion and re-run the complete sweep and review.

trees.name: Sheltering
trees.description: A 3-lobe crown, in a single broad tier, balanced squarely over the trunk, over a wide prop-root colonnade.

trees.name: High Crown
trees.description: A 3-lobe crown, in a single broad tier. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for how high the crown begins (+2.3σ).

trees.name: Long Limb
trees.description: A 4-lobe crown, in a single broad tier, balanced squarely over the trunk, spreading wider than it stands. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for reach of the longest limb past the crown (+2.28σ).

trees.name: Layered Storeys
trees.description: A 3-lobe crown, in two clear storeys, leaning distinctly off the trunk axis. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for layered storeys in the crown (+3σ).

trees.name: Level Crown
trees.description: A 3-lobe crown, in a single broad tier, balanced squarely over the trunk. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for canopy offset from the trunk axis (-1.24σ).

trees.name: Low Shelter
trees.description: A 4-lobe crown, in a single broad tier, spreading wider than it stands, over a wide prop-root colonnade. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for stature (-1.98σ).

trees.name: Wide Colonnade
trees.description: A many-lobed crown, in a single broad tier, over a wide prop-root colonnade. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for prop-root field spread (+2.16σ).

trees.name: Single Bough
trees.description: A two-lobed crown, in a single broad tier, leaning distinctly off the trunk axis. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for number of canopy lobes (-1.75σ).

trees.name: Mirrored Crown
trees.description: A 4-lobe crown, in a single broad tier, over a wide prop-root colonnade. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for 180-degree self-similarity (+1.21σ).

trees.name: Broken Canopy
trees.description: A 3-lobe crown, in a single broad tier. Within the Gold ten it is the outlier for unevenness of the crown top (+2.71σ).
